about.title: About Lingora
about.whatBody: Lingora helps a Deaf signer and a hearing person talk, for example at a first job interview. The phone recognises a few still signs, writes a sentence that the signer checks, and reads it aloud. The hearing person's reply appears as large text.
about.signsNote: Placeholder list. The final signs are chosen with a sign language consultant.
about.notFor.cta: In these situations, ask for a human interpreter.
about.limit1: It knows only a small set of single, still signs. It cannot follow continuous signing.
about.limit2: It can be wrong. You confirm every sign and every sentence before anything is read aloud.
about.limit3: It does not translate text into signs.
about.limit4: Read aloud depends on the voices installed on this device.
about.privacyBody: Video and audio never leave this device and are never stored. Only text labels and typed text are sent to the sentence service. There are no accounts and no tracking.
